description: Designed in collaboration with new-school tech powerhouse Murray Loubser, the all-new Wethepeople ARC Frame is a true embodiment of style, precision, and innovation. Built to tackle the streets and beyond, this frame represents a seamless blend of strength and agility, just like Murray's unique riding style. Blending the geometry and features of Murray’s favourite Wethepeople frames, the ARC Frame uses a shorter wheelbase and slacker seat tube angle to create a bike that is as nimble as it is tough. With meticulous attention to detail, the ARC Frame incorporates reinforced hydroformed tubing, thicker dropouts, and subtle CNC artwork, ensuring durability without sacrificing the sleek, streamlined appearance. A true representation of the progression of street riding.
